runtimeCrossCheck.note: The exact dedicated-server runtime independently proved that entry+0x13 is the decoder-format index and its direct decoder wrapper accepts only codes 0 and 8. Codec names are supplied by the pinned T6 source enum and physical payload closure, not guessed from server linkage.

behavior.0: validate exact PCM16 byte count, then add only a standard RIFF/WAVE PCM16 header; sample payload is unchanged
behavior.8: require native fLaC marker and write exact payload bytes unchanged

closedFacts: Every physical sound-bank entry in the exact 116-bank PC corpus is either format code 0 or format code 8.
All 4746 observed PCMS16 payloads have exact signed-16-bit interleaved PCM byte size.
All 20700 observed FLAC payloads are native FLAC streams beginning with fLaC.
No proprietary decompression transform is required before standard FLAC decoding for the observed format-8 PC payloads.
proofBoundary: Authoritative for codec identity and encoded-payload handling in the exact retained 116-bank T6 PC corpus.
